overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a contract-termination motion that arose from two posted agenda topics did not need its own notice line, though the AG recommended tabling unplanned topics of public interest for later notice as best practice.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the Authority voted to terminate a contract at its Nov. 16, 2018 meeting though the possibility of that vote was not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the discussion and vote to terminate the contract with JOBS was not anticipated in advance of the meeting, but rather arose organically from the discussion of the anticipated topics that were included in the meeting notice.
